description: Run shell commands on a remote host via SSH as a Dagster asset.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key for this component.

host_env_var.label: Host Env Var
host_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the hostname or IP address of the remote host.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the SSH username.

private_key_env_var.label: Private Key Env Var
private_key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the PEM-encoded SSH private key content (not a file path). The component writes it to a secure temporary file with mode 0600 and deletes it after the run.

private_key_path_env_var.label: Private Key Path Env Var
private_key_path_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the path to an SSH private key file already present on disk. Takes precedence over ``private_key_env_var`` when both are set.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the SSH password. Used as a fallback when no private key option is provided.

port.label: Port
port.description: SSH port on the remote host.

known_hosts_check.label: Known Hosts Check
known_hosts_check.description: When False (default), ``AutoAddPolicy`` is applied so the client accepts any host key without prompting. Set to True to use the system known_hosts file and reject unknown host keys — recommended for security-sensitive environments.

commands.label: Commands
commands.description: Ordered list of shell commands to execute on the remote host.

working_dir.label: Working Dir
working_dir.description: Remote directory to change into before running commands. Prepended as ``cd <working_dir> && `` to each command.

fail_on_non_zero.label: Fail On Non Zero
fail_on_non_zero.description: Raise an exception when any command exits with a non-zero status code.

sftp_upload.label: Sftp Upload
sftp_upload.description: If provided, upload a local file to the remote host via SFTP before running commands. Expected keys: ``local_path`` (str) and ``remote_path`` (str).

sftp_download.label: Sftp Download
sftp_download.description: If provided, download a remote file to the local filesystem via SFTP after all commands complete. Expected keys: ``remote_path`` (str) and ``local_path`` (str).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

description.label: Description
description.description: Human-readable description surfaced in the Dagster UI.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', or None for unpartitioned. With a partition type set, the partition key is exposed via context.partition_key for use in filtering / templating.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required when partition_type is set.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage, emitted as `dagster/column_lineage` metadata on every materialization: {output column: [upstream columns]}, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}. The upstream asset is `upstream_asset_key`, or the only entry of `deps`; with several upstream assets, name each column '<asset_key>:<column>'. Ignored with a warning when no upstream asset can be resolved.

partition_date_column.description: Unused by this component -- there is no DataFrame to filter here (it runs shell commands over SSH). commands/working_dir support {partition_key} templating directly instead -- see Partition Type. Kept for schema consistency with the rest of the ingestion components.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme,globex,initech'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer'.
partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim

partition_static_column.description: Unused by this component -- there is no DataFrame to filter here (it runs shell commands over SSH). Kept for schema consistency with the rest of the ingestion components.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run: commands/working_dir are templated with {partition_key} and run once PER partition key in the range, over a single reused SSH connection. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: SSH Asset
